title: The Midnight Invoice
briefing: Rookie. Horizon Realty Developers's internal audit flagged something, then went home. One of these five has slipped a monster invoice past the system. Careful — the boss spends big on everything, and big isn't the same as crooked. Compare people with themselves.

suspects.name: Vikram Kapoor
suspects.bio: Built the firm from a Dadar garage. Spends like a man who owns the building — because he does.

suspects.name: Farhan Qureshi
suspects.bio: Runs the warehouse like a ship. Nobody has ever seen the captain's log.

suspects.name: Ananya Rao
suspects.bio: Organises every offsite. Somehow the venue is always her cousin's resort.

suspects.name: Aditya Banerjee
suspects.bio: Quiet, punctual, works weekends. Nobody asks why.

suspects.name: Divya Menon
suspects.bio: Her campaigns go viral. So do her expense reports, around the office.
